scope: Completed multi-donor differential-expression audit input consistency

requirements: donor_ids is a nonempty list of unique nonempty strings
donor_ids set exactly matches donors parsed from supplied metadata
n_donors exactly matches parsed donor count
donor_ids key is absent rather than malformed
sample_metadata is a readable CSV or TSV file path
sample_metadata_sha256 is a nonzero lowercase 64-hex digest
digest exactly matches original sample metadata file bytes
the table parsed from those bytes equals the table audited
n_donors exactly matches parsed donor count

forbidden_fallbacks: derive donor binding from an in-memory DataFrame
repair a present but malformed donor_ids value
accept a missing, malformed, all-zero or mismatched sample_metadata_sha256
replace or rewrite a historical receipt
treat matching hashes as proof that the model ran or that the producer is authentic
